title: Nuclear Extraction from Tissue for FACS
author: anita.adami
materials: Put 2.8 mL, sucrose solution in centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Coat Tubes
steps.instruction: Coat all centrifugation, sample, and collection tubes in coating medium (1% (v/v) BSA, filtered) overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the ultracentrifuge and the lysis/sucrose mixture.

substeps.instruction: Cool ultracentrifuge to 4 °C prior to centrifugation.
Mix 6 mL sucrose and 2 mL lysis solution in a 15 mL falcon tube.

steps.title: Process Tissue
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue and homogenize it using a douncer.

substeps.instruction: If the tissue is larger than 2 mm3, chop it with a razor.
Collect chopped tissue with 0.5 mL lysis buffer and transfer to a douncer.
Repeat with another 0.5 mL lysis buffer to ensure all tissue is collected.

steps.title: Extract Nuclei
steps.instruction: Combine the homogenized tissue with the sucrose/lysis mixture to recover nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Pour douncer content into the falcon tube containing the sucrose/lysis buffer mixture and flip upside down a few times.
Pour 1 mL of the tube content back and forth into the douncer to collect remaining nuclei.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Layer the mixture and spin in the ultracentrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Carefully layer the 8.5 mL mix of lysis/sucrose/nuclei on top of sucrose in the centrifuge tube.
Spin at 15,500 rpm (or 30,000 x g, rotor dependent) for 02:15:00.

steps.title: Recover Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and soften the resulting pellet.

substeps.instruction: Carefully aspirate off the supernatant without disturbing the pellet, ensuring the inside of the tube is cleared despite viscosity.
Soften the pellet for 00:10:00 in 50 µL medium A.

steps.title: Filter and Prepare for FACS
steps.instruction: Dilute the nuclei and filter them into coated tubes for sorting.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL dilution buffer (containing a nuclei marker, such as Draq7).
Filter the mixture using 70 µm pipette tip filters into coated tubes.

steps.title: Perform FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort the nuclei using specific settings to manage sucrose viscosity.

substeps.instruction: Set FACS to low flowrate, largest nozzle, and cooling system on.
To avoid sucrose-related problems, add dilution buffer (with nuclei marker) 100 µL at a time (typically 300 µL - 400 µL total) before starting to sort.

steps.title: Optional: Single Nuclei Sequencing (10x)
steps.instruction: Prepare pipette tips for 10x machine loading.

substeps.instruction: Pre-coat the required pipette tips according to the coating procedure in step 1.
Pellet nuclei at 1,300 x g for 00:15:00 at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and snap freeze for later extraction, OR resuspend in 350 µL RLT including beta-mercaptoethanol directly.
Use RNeasy micro columns for extraction.
For very small volumes, resuspend in RLT without pelleting.
